register_message: register a protobuf message type in the SymbolDatabase for later lookup by symbol name
get_symbol: get a registered protobuf message class from the SymbolDatabase by its fully qualified symbol name
get_messages: get all registered message classes from a specified proto file as a dictionary mapping names to classes
register_enum_descriptor: register a protobuf enum descriptor in the SymbolDatabase descriptor pool for later reference
default_symbol_database: get the default singleton SymbolDatabase instance shared across the protobuf runtime
